**Step 1:** Calculate the total number of yogurts Terry eats in 30 days.
$$2 \text{ yogurts/day} \times 30 \text{ days} = 60 \text{ yogurts}$$

**Step 2:** Determine how many packs of 4 yogurts Terry needs to buy.
$$60 \text{ yogurts} \div 4 \text{ yogurts/pack} = 15 \text{ packs}$$

**Step 3:** Calculate the total cost.
$$15 \text{ packs} \times \$5.00/\text{pack} = \$75.00$$

*(Alternatively: Each yogurt costs $\$5.00 \div 4 = \$1.25$. Then $60 \text{ yogurts} \times \$1.25 = \$75.00$.)*

\boxed{$75.00}
